item.name: level_2

item.name: fully
item.label: Fully accurate – all trips were correctly recorded

item.name: mostly
item.label: Mostly accurate – minor issues only (e.g., one wrong mode)

item.name: partially
item.label: Partially accurate – some trips missed or details incorrect

item.name: inaccurate
item.label: Mostly inaccurate – significant trips or details missing

item.name: not_recorded
item.label: App did not record any trips
